Title: Caprica
Introduction: Twelve views of Caprica, an Earth-like planet, and Fresno, the lava drop it orbits. Amber, the yellow gas giant close to the larger star, and Azure, the blue ice giant, are not yet included in these views.
ArtDirection: This is invented imagery. Fresno’s temperature and age, cloud appearance, cameras and exposures are artistic choices; the scene is not presented as a scientifically realistic world. Atmospheric and cloud references inform the wider renderer, but this scene is not an implementation or validation of either cited model. The drop radius relation noted in the source handoff has not been independently pinned.

Sources.Title: Bruneton and Neyret — Precomputed Atmospheric Scattering (2008)
Schneider and Vos — Nubis cloud rendering (2017)

Frames.Title: Caprica in light
Frames.Caption: A mostly illuminated orange globe, with textured cloud tops, a dark crescent and clusters of dark flecks.

Frames.Title: Caprica in quarter phase
Frames.Caption: An orange, textured day deck meets the dark blue-gray night side; dark flecks trace parts of the bright limb.

Frames.Title: Night crescent
Frames.Caption: A dim blue crescent reveals green and blue ground among pale broken clouds and stars.

Frames.Title: At the terminator
Frames.Caption: A close crop of the dark-to-orange terminator and bright curved limb, with a ragged cloud boundary.

Frames.Title: Above the deck
Frames.Caption: A curved orange cloud deck fills the frame, with a ridged whorl and textured tops.

Frames.Title: Night close-up
Frames.Caption: An intimate blue night crop with faint green terrain.

Frames.Title: North over the clouds
Frames.Caption: A high-angle view across an orange deck, with a rough dark boundary, a bright curved limb and scattered dark flecks.

Frames.Title: A distant light
Frames.Caption: A slender golden cloud limb curves beneath a separate point of light, which shows no surface detail.

Frames.Title: Fresno
Frames.Caption: A red-brown globe is crossed by a network of bright molten seams.

Frames.Title: Fresno close-up
Frames.Caption: A partial view of red-brown crust and luminous seams, whose bright centers approach white.

Frames.Title: Caprica from the reverse side
Frames.Caption: An orange reverse view of Caprica, with dark boundary bands; its framing overlaps with the earlier quarter view.

Frames.Title: Lava-seam horizon
Frames.Caption: Luminous seams converge near Fresno’s curved horizon; this close view shares its subject with the earlier Fresno close-up.
